_recorded.note: Recorded with curl, User-Agent 'pinakes-dev/0.1 (+https://pubky.app; info@synonym.to)', at most one request a second to MusicBrainz. Derived and synthetic answers the tests build in code (tests/music_enrichment.rs, one edit each): wd-p18-no-author (Daft Punk's wd-p18-Q185828 answer with its file name replaced by the no-author file's); wd-pages-Q55825905 without its English description (the descriptions object emptied); wd-search-P434-sefa-empty (Sefa's P434 search with no hit: search emptied, totalhits 0), wd-search-P434-sefa-crowded (totalhits set to 6, more than the 5 a search returns), wd-search-P1953-empty (a Discogs search with no hit, built the same way from wd-search-P1953-6743320); wd-search-P4404-get-lucky-empty (Get Lucky's P4404 search with no hit, built the same way); wd-entities-Q55825905-other-mbid (the read-back with its P434 value replaced by another artist's MBID, 561d854a-6a28-4aa7-8c99-323e6ce46c2a); mb-recording-get-lucky-works-no-work-item (Get Lucky's works answer with its work's wikidata URL relation removed); Wikipedia's 503 with Retry-After: 120, Commons' 429, Wikidata's 503 (status and header only, no body recorded) and Wikidata's maxlag error ({"error":{"code":"maxlag"}} with status 200, as Wikidata sends it). Added 2026-11-10 (round 2; recorded with User-Agent 'pinakes/0.1.0 (+https://pubky.app)', at most one request a second): the read-backs of the items the entities' own relations name, and the Kind of Blue release. Derived answers built in code: mb-recording-get-lucky-names-its-song (Get Lucky's recording answer with a wikidata URL relation to its song's item Q11510350 added, as Daft Punk's relation is written); mb-release-kind-of-blue with a wikidata URL relation to the album's item Q283221 added the same way. Also 2026-11-10: the item of English Wikipedia's 'Get Lucky' disambiguation page, Q5554322 (read-back, pages, image claim). Derived: mb-artist-daft-punk-names-disambiguation (Daft Punk's answer with its wikidata relation's Q185828 replaced by Q5554322); wd-entities-Q5554322-unclassed (that item's read-back with its P31 claims removed); wd-pages-Q139827657-disambiguation-sitelink (Get Lucky's recording item's pages with an enwiki sitelink to the 'Get Lucky' disambiguation page added). Round 3 (2026-11-10), derived in code: an MB answer whose wikidata relation names an item of another kind instead of its own, or has one added (Mode::relation: Daft Punk's naming Kind of Blue's album item Q283221, Kind of Blue's release group naming Miles Davis's item Q93341, Kind of Blue's release naming Get Lucky's recording item Q139827657); wd-entities-Q283221-with-work (Kind of Blue's item read back with its P436 claim copied as a P435 claim with a made-up work MBID f4a8b9d2-3c1e-4f5a-9b6c-7d8e9f0a1b2c); Get Lucky's works answer with its work's wikidata relation naming Q139827657, Q283221 or Q93341 instead of Q11510350; Wikidata's and MusicBrainz's 410 Gone (Mode::gone: status only, body {}), for an item read-back, a search, the item's pages and image claim, and a recording's works. Added 2026-11-10 (album covers): the four MusicBrainz answers re-recorded with the ratings inc (mb-release-group-kind-of-blue, mb-artist-miles-davis, mb-artist-sefa, mb-recording-get-lucky; only `rating` changed), and the Cover Art Archive's answers to front-500 (caa-*: status, content type and Location, recorded with User-Agent 'pinakes/0.1.0 (+https://pubky.app)', at most one request a second). Derived in code: Kind of Blue's release group answered with the recorded 404 (caa-front-500-unknown); a release's cover-art-archive front set to false; a rating with votes-count 0 or out of range; a wikidata relation that is no item link; Kind of Blue's item read back with an image claim (wd-p18-Q283221 given Miles Davis's recorded P18 claim) for the Commons-wins case. Derived in code for the GNU licences: commons-daft-punk as Commons writes a file under {{GPL}} (License removed, LicenseShortName "GPL", LicenseUrl "http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl.html"), with its author and with Artist removed too (Mode::daft_punk_gpl).
